headline_marked: [[Jensen Huang-signed RTX 5090]] bought used, now valued at $15,000
headline: Jensen Huang-signed RTX 5090 bought used, now valued at $15,000
summary: A 3D artist purchased an unopened graphics card expecting an executive signature, but found Nvidia's CEO's autograph instead. The unique GPU is now headed for auction.
details: A 3D artist acquired an unopened Asus ROG Astral RTX 5090 White OC from the secondhand market, believing it was signed by an Asus executive. Upon opening the package, they discovered it was autographed by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

This specific graphics card was originally intended as a giveaway to a lucky gamer after Huang signed it. The artist, who did not disclose the purchase price, opted to sell the card due to its significant collectible value.

New RTX 5090 models can currently fetch prices up to $5,000, but this autographed edition is expected to command much higher. It is slated for auction at Bonhams from October 4-14, 2026, with an estimated value between $10,000 and $15,000.

The potential value could be even higher, as similar autographed GPUs have sold for more. An Asus ROG Matrix RTX 4090 signed by Huang sold for $16,000 in 2023, and an Asus ROG Astral RTX 5090 Dhabab OC Edition fetched $24,200 at auction last year.

Huang's popularity, particularly in Taiwan where he is seen as a national pride figure, has fueled a market for his autographed memorabilia. Fans are willing to spend substantial amounts for these unique items, as demonstrated by the record-breaking auction of his Tom Ford jacket for $960,000.
